compression_level.description: Compression level (0–9); default 6. 0 = fastest, 9 = best compression.

dictionary_size.description: Dictionary size in bytes. Values 12–29 are interpreted as powers of two (2^12 to 2^29). Default 8 MiB (2^23 = 8388608 bytes).

match_length.description: Match length limit in bytes. Default 36.

member_size.description: Member size limit for multimember files in bytes (0 = unlimited).

volume_size.description: Volume size limit in bytes for splitting output (0 = no splitting).

decompress.description: Decompress (or test integrity if no decompression target).

test.description: Test compressed file integrity only (do not write output).

list.description: Print (un)compressed file sizes and other info to stdout.

stdout.description: Write to standard output; do not delete input files.

keep.description: Keep (do not delete) input files after (de)compression.

trailing_error.description: Exit with error status if trailing data is present after decompression.

loose_trailing.description: Allow trailing data that appears to be from a corrupted header (not standard lzip).

recompress.description: Force recompression even if the file is already compressed with clzip.

output_file.description: Explicit output file path (implies -c if used with -d or -t).

input_files.description: List of input files to compress/decompress. Use '-' for stdin/stdout. If empty, clzip uses stdin/stdout by default.
